title: Data and analysis code for "Evaluating the applicability domain of an AI affinity predictor against standardized membrane-protein binding measurements"
description: Target-level aggregate data and analysis code supporting the manuscript "Evaluating the applicability domain of an AI affinity predictor against standardized membrane-protein binding measurements". The archive contains per-target screening outcomes, structural classifications and structure-derived descriptors for 295 G protein-coupled receptors and 296 solute carrier transporters; consolidated virtual-screening metrics with bootstrap confidence intervals for the 43 targets with complete compound-level binding data; public-data proxies for representation in the model's training domain; measures of the consistency of model-generated ligand placements; held-out evaluations of the separation index; and the scripts used to reproduce the reported downstream statistical analyses from these files. Per-compound experimental data and model predictions are not included; they are not required to reproduce the reported downstream statistical analyses, but the compound-level evaluation cannot be independently repeated without them. Code is released under the MIT License; data are released under CC BY 4.0.
